message.name: MeetingNotificationV13
message.definition: Scope|The MeetingNotification message is sent by a notifying party, for example, an issuer, its agent or an intermediary to another intermediary, a party holding the right to vote, a registered security holder or to a beneficial holder to announce a meeting.|Usage|The MeetingNotification message is used to announce a meeting, for example, it provides information on the participation details and requirements for the meeting, the vote parameters and the resolutions. The MeetingNotification message may also be used to announce an update.|This message definition is intended for use with the Business Application Header (BAH).

rules.name: DateStatus1Rule
rules.text: If DateAndTime/DateCode is "UKWN" (Unknown), then DateStatus must not be present.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: RightsHolderMultiplicity1Guideline
rules.text: It is recommended that RightsHolder is only present more than once if there is joint ownership.

rules.name: HoldingBalanceTypeRule
rules.text: In all occurrences of HoldingBalance, one and only one BalanceType may be ELIG (Eligible).

rules.name: AccountIdentificationOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: Either AccountIdentification or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.

rules.name: AccountIdentificationOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present then AccountIdentification must be absent.

rules.name: AccountIdentificationOrBlockChainAddress3Rule
rules.text: If AccountIdentification is present, then BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: AdditionalInformationRule
rules.text: If  AdditionalInformation is present, then VoteInstructionTypeCode/Proprietary/Identification must be present.

rules.name: VotingRightsTresholdForApproval1Rule
rules.text: If VotingRightThresholdForApproval is present more than once, then ThresholdBasis is mandatory in each occurrence of VotingRightThresholdForApproval and the value of the ThresholdBasis/Code element must be different in each occurrence.

rules.name: OtherDocumentation1Guideline
rules.text: If power of attorney specific deadlines are announced, it is recommended that OtherDocumentation is used.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: Resolution1Guideline
rules.text: When an agenda item needs to be linked to a resolution, it is recommended that the resolution information directly follows the agenda item information to which the resolution is linked, as illustrated in the following example:|Resolution/IssuerLabel = Agenda item 1|Description = <Item description.>|ForInformationOnly = True|Type =.||Directly followed by||Resolution/IssuerLabel = Resolution 1|Description = <Resolution description.>|ForInformationOnly = False|Type =.|.

rules.name: VoteInstructionType1Guideline
rules.text: If all of the vote instructions types are to be the same for all resolutions, it is recommended that only the element Vote/VoteInstructionType is used. If the vote instruction types are not going to be the same for each resolution, then it is recommended that only the element Resolution/VoteInstructionType in each occurrence of Resolution is used.

rules.name: EntitlementDate1Guideline
rules.text: If both Meeting/EntitlementFixingDate and Security/Position/HoldingBalance/Date are present, it is recommended that both date values be identical.

rules.name: PreviousNotificationIdentificationRule
rules.text: If NotificationGeneralInformation/NotificationType is REPL (Replacement) and Pagination/PageNumber is equal to value 1, then NotificationUpdate/PreviousNotificationIdentification must be present.

rules.name: AgentRole1Rule
rules.text: IssuerAgent/Role PRIN (PrincipalAgent) can only be present in a single occurrence of IssuerAgent.

rules.name: VoteAsPerIntermediary1Rule
rules.text: If Vote/VoteMethod/VoteThroughNetwork/VoteChannel code value is VOPI (VoteAsPerIntermediaryInformation), then at least one occurrence of AdditionalInformation/ProcessingTextForNextIntermediary must be present.

rules.name: PaginationRule
rules.text: If pagination is present, then NotificationGeneralInformation/NotificationIdentification must be present.

rules.name: AttendeeEmailRequiredIndicator1Rule
rules.text: If participation method is VIRT, then AttendeeEmailRequiredIndicator must be set to Y.

rules.name: AttendeeEmailRequiredIndicator2Rule
rules.text: If participation method is VIRT, then the email address of the party who will attend the virtual meeting must be provided in the Meeting Instruction.
